scope: All208 exposed development, all154 original real pairs. Do not select GPU inputs by oracle.
reference_acceptance: Full phrase raw logodds>=.5 and image-gray evidence>=.5 only. modifier_increment is diagnostic, NEVER acceptance/rejection.
subject_comparison: Fixed A/B/U logits on masked/context pair panels, both object orders and matching blank; support requires both views and both orders raw margin>=.5 over other candidate and U, image-vs-blank candidate margin>=.5. No category comparison.
relation_policy: Use current no-increment reference graph and camera projection. Spatial evidence can distinguish when subject comparison is unknown, cannot override a clear subject preference for A. Known B contradiction vetoes. Described reference-person B preference conflicts with target B preference => abstain on role ambiguity.
offline_recoverability: GT stratifies source-fail/offered-best IoU>.25 and all256 recoverability only in scorer after all predictions sealed. No runtime filtering or oracle selection.
TTA_gate: No TTA unless full vs matched pair-no-reference has positive relation gain and no harmful relation decisions on recoverable offered-candidate strata and all-sample results, then separate current-input validation with scene-cluster positive lowerbound. No threshold sweeps.
